instruction: Write an XDP program that must prepend 4-byte 802.1Q tag 302 to ingress raw Ethernet frames using adjust_head. Forward all packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Verify Ethernet header bounds against data_end
Check if frame is untagged IPv4 (eth->h_proto == ETH_P_IP)
Invoke bpf_xdp_adjust_head(ctx, -(int)sizeof(struct vlan_hdr)) to expand head by 4 bytes
Re-validate packet pointers and rewrite Ethernet header with ETH_P_8021Q
Insert struct vlan_hdr with vlan_id == 302 and encapsulated ETH_P_IP
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration

tests.name: pass_untagged_pushed
tests.description: Untagged pushed with VLAN 302 and passed
